s01_topology.title: Topology. The shape of a program: primary aspect, process, functions, procedures, regions.

s02_logic.title: Logic. The truth values and their operators; an error here is absurd and obvious.

s03_numeric.title: Numbers. Zero, one, the extremes of the types, the operators and the literals.

s04_string.title: Strings. The empty string, concatenation, comparison, escapes and placeholders.

s05_collection.title: Collections. The empty ones, zero values, one element, indexes from 1, literals.

s06_variables.title: Variables. new, set and let; constants; sharing and copying; scopes.

s07_constants.title: Constants. set declares a value that never changes: typed or not, global or local.

s08_constant_assign.title: A constant can't be changed. Assigning it is a compile error and nothing runs.

s09_operators.title: Operators. Precedence, compound forms, list operators, ranges, membership.

s10_control.title: Control flow. if, while, loop, for, match, break, skip, labels, the if suffix.

s11_subprograms.title: Subprograms. Functions, procedures, arguments, recursion, lambdas, closures.

s12_errors.title: Errors. raise and recover, jobs with resume, error codes, defer, exit, over, finalize.

s13_types.title: Types. type(), is, conversions, optional values, ordinals, variants.

s14_objects.title: Objects. Class, methods, visibility, inheritance, extension, comparison.

s15_placeholders.title: Placeholders. Names, literals, expressions, formats, code points, entities, braces.

s16_project.title: A project. One module, one aspect, one apply: import, life cycle order, safe and Atomic.

s17_tasks.title: Tasks. async procedures spawned in a job, an async function awaited, a job that waits for all of them.

s18_generics.title: Generics and traits. A generic procedure, a generic class, a trait with a required and a provided method.

s19_data.title: Data files. Records in a Table, written as CSV and as JSON Lines, read back typed; Decimal keeps its scale.

s20_database.title: Database. SQLite of the machine: a table, typed parameters, records, a job that rolls back, a Memory table there and back.

s21_machine.title: The machine. A listening machine runs a script sent with -loc, the stdio door runs session commands, --listen stop ends it.
